Strategy: Multiple-of-item complementarity: add a large bonus when a bin's residual is an exact multiple of the item size, otherwise score by tightest fit; such bins can later be filled exactly by same-size items, so they are worth steering toward. It can fail when multiples are rare or when the bonus overrides a much tighter fit.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (500.0 if r % item == 0 else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
